stem_md: 设 $z=xg(x+y)+y\varphi(xy)$，其中 $g,\varphi$ 有二阶连续导数，求 $z_{xy}$。
analysis_md:
由 $z=xg(x+y)+y\varphi(xy)$ 知 $\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}=g(x+y)+xg'(x+y)+y^2\varphi'(xy)$

$$\frac{\partial^2z}{\partial x\partial y}=g'(x+y)+xg''(x+y)+2y\varphi'(xy)+xy^2\varphi''(xy)$$
search_text:
设 $z=xg(x+y)+y\varphi(xy)$，其中 $g,\varphi$ 有二阶连续导数，求 $z_{xy}$。 $g'(x+y)+xg''(x+y)+2y\varphi'(xy)+y^2\varphi''(xy)$ $g'(x+y)+xg''(x+y)+2y\varphi'(xy)+xy^2\varphi''(xy)$ $g'(x+y)+g''(x+y)+2y\varphi'(xy)+xy^2\varphi''(xy)$ $g'(x+y)+2y\varphi'(xy)+xy^2\varphi''(xy)$ 由 $z=xg(x+y)+y\varphi(xy)$ 知 $\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}=g(x+y)+xg'(x+y)+y^2\varphi'(xy)$

$$\frac{\partial^2z}{\partial x\partial y}=g'(x+y)+xg''(x+y)+2y\varphi'(xy)+xy^2\varphi''(xy)$$
